messages:
alice: Hey @channel — planning to flip the config_swap feature flag to enable per-tenant batching tonight. Target window 23:00–23:30 PST. Who's on deploy + smoke?

ben: I can push and watch until 23:15. Can someone run the smoke checklist and keep an eye on latency?

dana: I can own smoke checks & dashboards. Which SLOs should I focus on?

alice: Primary: 95p latency for gen-api, error-rate (5xx) threshold 0.5%, and queue backlog. Safe-defaults: fallback to global-batching when error-rate > 0.7% or queue backlog > 300. Rollback plan: immediate flag-off + scale down batchers by 50%.

alice: Quick deploy snippet for reference:
```
# toggle flag for canary tenants
redwoodctl feature flip --flag=config_swap --tenants=canary --value=on --reason="phased enable"
```

ben: Plan: do canary at 23:00 (10% traffic, 15m), then 50% at 23:20 if green. ops-bot, please schedule the alert runbook.

ops-bot: Scheduled: alert runbook kick at 23:00. Notifying oncall channel.

ci-bot: CI pipeline is green. Canary job ready. Auto-rollback threshold configured: 3 consecutive 5xx in a 2m window triggers flag-off.

sam: Oncall here 23:00–00:30. I'll take rollback if needed.

dana: Smoke checklist (I'll run these live):
- Verify model 95p latency < 400ms
- Error rate < 0.5% (monitor 1m and 5m windows)
- Token-cost per request: no >5% regression
- KV cache hit rate stable (no >10% drop)
- Task queue backlog < 200

ben: Logs I'll tail: `kubectl logs -f svc/proxy -n inference --tail=200 | grep "config_swap"`

alice: Thanks. After canary ping me in this thread. Rollback command (handy): `redwoodctl feature set --flag=config_swap --value=off --reason="rollback - perf regress"`

dana: ack :thumbsup: I'll post metrics snapshots at 23:10 and 23:25.

sam: I'll call the rollback if I see the auto-rollback fire and it's not clearing. Will post a short summary to #general if stable.

ben: Sounds good. See you all at 23:00.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for deployment coordination: feature flag toggle, smoke checks, rollback readiness. No title field as per agents.md.
